# Aetheria Aesthetics & Wellness

> Medical aesthetics and wellness practice in Pittsburgh's North Hills offering injectables, energy-based skin treatments, medical weight loss, and peptide therapy. Conservative dosing, evidence-based treatment plans, and continuity of care.

Aetheria Aesthetics & Wellness is a boutique medical aesthetics practice in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, located inside Sola Salon Studios at Ross Park Mall in the North Hills. The practice provides injectable treatments, radiofrequency and microneedling devices, laser services, medical weight loss, peptide therapy, and medical-grade skincare. The clinical approach emphasizes conservative initial dosing, two-week follow-up assessment, and long-term aesthetic planning over high-volume single-visit treatment.

## Key facts

- **Practice name:** Aetheria Aesthetics & Wellness
- **Address:** 1000 Ross Park Mall Dr, Suite 4B, Pittsburgh, PA 15237
- **Phone:** (412) 385-3191
- **Hours:** Monday and Tuesday 12pm–8pm, Thursday and Friday 10am–5pm, Saturday 10am–3pm. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.
- **Booking:** https://aetheriaaesthetics.myaestheticrecord.com/online-booking/v2
- **Service area:** Pittsburgh, PA and surrounding communities including the North Hills, Cranberry Township, Wexford, Ross Township, McCandless, Sewickley, Hampton, and the greater Allegheny County region.

## Injectable and neurotoxin services

- [Botox and Xeomin in Pittsburgh's North Hills](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/botox-pittsburgh/): FDA-approved neuromodulator treatments using Botox (onabotulinumtoxinA) and Xeomin (incobotulinumtoxinA) for glabellar lines, forehead, crow's feet, masseter, lip flip, and platysmal neck bands
- [Dermal Fillers](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/dermal-fillers-pittsburgh/): Hyaluronic acid dermal fillers for lip enhancement, midface volume, cheek definition, and lower-face contouring
- [Sculptra](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/sculptra-pittsburgh/): Poly-L-lactic acid biostimulator treatments for gradual collagen restoration and facial volume
- [RHA Redensity](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/rha-redensity/): Resilient hyaluronic acid filler indicated for perioral fine lines
- [RHA 2](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/rha-2/): Resilient hyaluronic acid filler indicated for moderate dynamic wrinkles
- [RHA 4](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/rha-4/): Resilient hyaluronic acid filler indicated for deeper folds and structural volume

## Skin and energy-based device services

- [Morpheus8](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/morpheus8/): Radiofrequency microneedling for collagen remodeling and skin tightening, with multiple depth configurations selected by treatment area
- [QuantumRF](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/quantumrf/): Minimally invasive radiofrequency for fat reduction, skin tightening, and jawline definition
- [RF Microneedling](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/rf-microneedling-pittsburgh/): Microneedling combined with radiofrequency energy for skin tightening and texture improvement
- [Microneedling](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/microneedling-pittsburgh/): Traditional microneedling for skin texture, tone, and topical product delivery
- [Chemical Peels](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/chemical-peels/): Targeted chemical resurfacing peels for tone, texture, and pigmentation
- [Laser Hair Removal](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/laser-hair/): Long-term laser hair reduction by treatment area
- [Spider Vein Removal](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/spider-vein-removal-pittsburgh/): Sclerotherapy treatment for visible leg veins

## Wellness and medical services

- [Metabolic Health](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/metabolic-health/): In-person clinical program combining GLP-1 weight management, peptide therapy, vitamin injections, and ongoing labs with Melissa Kolowitz, PA-C (the hub for the services below)
- [Medical Weight Loss](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/medical-weight-loss-pittsburgh/): Medically supervised weight loss programs including GLP-1 medication management (semaglutide, tirzepatide)
- [Peptide Therapy](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/peptide-therapy-pittsburgh/): Peptide protocols for recovery, longevity, and metabolic support (NAD+, sermorelin, ipamorelin, tesamorelin, GHK-Cu)
- [Vitamin Injections](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/vitamin-injections-pittsburgh/): Clinician-selected nutrient injections (Super MIC, B-Complex, glutathione)

## Medical-grade skincare

- [ZO Skin Health](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/zo-skin-health-pittsburgh/): Professional skincare line for daily skin protection and post-treatment maintenance
- [Curated Supplements](https://www.aetheriaaesthetics.com/curated-supplements/): Curated Ancient Nutrition supplements (collagen, probiotics, super greens, multivitamin) recommended to support aesthetic and wellness plans

## Clinical approach

- Initial treatments are dosed conservatively, with reassessment at a two-week follow-up to determine whether additional product is indicated.
- Treatment plans are developed in consultation and refined across visits to support continuity of care.
- Per-unit pricing is not published; treatment pricing is determined at consultation based on clinical assessment.
- Two-week follow-up appointments for neurotoxin treatments are included at no additional charge.
- Both Xeomin (incobotulinumtoxinA) and Botox (onabotulinumtoxinA) are offered; product selection is determined at consultation based on treatment area, patient history, and clinical indication.

## Service area

Aetheria serves patients throughout the Pittsburgh metropolitan area, including the North Hills, downtown Pittsburgh, and the northern suburbs. Specific communities served include Cranberry Township, Wexford, Ross Township, McCandless, Sewickley, Hampton Township, Franklin Park, Marshall Township, Pine Township, Allison Park, Gibsonia, and Mars. Patients also travel from the South Hills, the Strip District, Lawrenceville, Shadyside, Squirrel Hill, and surrounding regions of Allegheny County, Butler County, and Beaver County.

## Treatment categories at a glance

- **Neuromodulators:** Botox, Xeomin
- **Hyaluronic acid fillers:** RHA Redensity, RHA 2, RHA 4, and additional HA filler products
- **Biostimulators:** Sculptra
- **Radiofrequency devices:** Morpheus8, QuantumRF, RF microneedling
- **Microneedling:** Traditional microneedling
- **Chemical resurfacing:** Chemical peels
- **Laser treatments:** Laser hair removal
- **Vein treatment:** Sclerotherapy for spider veins
- **Medical weight management:** GLP-1 therapy
- **Peptide therapy:** Recovery, longevity, and metabolic peptide protocols
- **IV and IM nutrition:** B12, lipotropic, and nutrient injections
- **Topical skincare:** ZO Skin Health, Ancient Nutrition

## Booking and consultation

Consultations and treatments are scheduled online through Aesthetic Record at https://aetheriaaesthetics.myaestheticrecord.com/online-booking/v2 or by phone at (412) 385-3191. Consultations are 45 minutes and are typically booked two to three weeks in advance.
